freeze_policy.scientific_gate_outcome: Report actual root/review status; archive itself does not grant admission
preserve: actual v3 run and independent review outputs
fixed original C23D/central handoff copies and pins
exclude: private transfer URLs and helper temporary files
freeze_policy.old_primary_v1_raw: NOT_RECOVERED; preserve observed outcome/cost without fabricated originals

Library.create: native create_library_file; complete xattrs applied in same code invocation
Library.R3: fresh whole-file materialization for exact returned file_id/library_file_id into a distinct create-only readback directory; canonical helper verifies size/SHA256/CRC/all payloads
Library.materialization: Use current native helper only; record whether provider workspace transfer or actual URL GET. Never label metadata as bytes.

Dropbox.create: native upload_file once; poll returned operation until actual completed
Dropbox.R3: single-use download_link for exact returned file ID; one full GET per issued link into fresh path; no HEAD/Range probe; canonical helper verifies size/SHA256/CRC/all payloads

Drive.after: Library and Dropbox actual-byte R3 PASS
Drive.if_no_ACK: one exact final filename + folder + trashed=false reconciliation query; zero results does not prove absence; no retransmission

measurements: Actual local helper child CPU, coordinator CPU, wall and RSS; network operation timings separately; unmeasured global costs stay null
